text.text_excerpt: My favorite of the plentiful daiquiri bars in the French Quarter. We usually grab one and walk around the town. Highlights: - Least sweet of the ones I've had - Have a flavor called "Smurf in a Blender" - A bunch on Bourbon - Good amount of options on the wall Lowlights (my flip side to highlights): - Brain freeze (but that applies to all of these frozen treats no matter the chain) - I love the smurfs and felt kind of guilty with a blue tongue as evidence that I had eaten one :-O If we're close to one, I'll go in and get one again. :-)

This place is an open air bar right on the corner of Bourbon Street and Iberville next to Felix Oyster Bar. They have about 20 different daquiri flavors, many of them with house names, that I had to ask what they were. I asked what the most popular daquiri was there and bartender said it was the "Jester" named after the bar. I asked why it was so popular and she said it's because it has the highest content of alcohol....they use everclear. uhhh....I'll pass thank you. I don't want to be a contributing factor to the Bourbon Street puking scene. $9.00 for a daquiri...I had the strawberry and it was yummy.

This is one of many locations in the French Quarter where you will wander into because you just have to have one of their frozen drinks and maybe you'll even go all out and get yours in a gigantic souvenir cup. Odds are, if you find yourself here, you have already had several adult beverages to the point where even the pizza that has been sitting under the warmer for who knows how long might even look appetizing. On the plus side, there are many different flavors of beverages available and the friendly "bartender" will be more than happy to help you decide on which is truly the ideal one for you.
